title: Mandate 78 enforced: agents look for existing Apache-2.0 work before writing new code
goal: CEO directive 2026-11-12: make agents look for already available Apache-2.0 code, products, tools, services and frameworks before writing new code. Same rule as Mandate 78 section 2, so Mandate 78 is strengthened rather than a new mandate added: the scope names code, libraries, frameworks, tools, products and services with how each is reused, and the look is enforced at commit. Call `susi-commercial workflow reuse <task>` from .githooks/commit-msg; bring the lint's reuse_gap in step with the tool (`searched` required); update docs/ceo-mandate-78.md, .agents/identity.json, AGENTS.md and the task schema.
limitations: The rule is implemented twice, in core's lint (advice) and in the commercial workflow tool (refusal), because core cannot depend on the commercial crate; both must be kept in step.
The hook is local and can be skipped with --no-verify, and it runs only where the shared tool is installed.
It proves the look was recorded, not that it was thorough.

reuse.searched: Both repositories: the commit-msg hook, the task records and distill lint already exist and the rule already had a lint check; this task calls the shared tool from the existing hook instead of writing a second checker in core.
